items.title: Canadian National Railway (TSX:CNR) Secures North America Access Deal With Union Pacific
items.summary: Canadian National Railway (TSX:CNR) and Union Pacific signed an operating rights agreement granting each company key access across North America. The arrangement provides Canadian National Railway with improved reach between Canada, the U.S. Midwest, and Mexico. Union Pacific gains a congestion free bypass around Chicago as part of the agreement.
